record.paper_title: Open Problems on Open Algebraic Varieties (Montreal 1994 Problems)
record.original_question: Does there exist a non-rational exotic C^n?

evidence.quote: 2.7. PROBLEM. Does there exist a non-rational exotic Cn ?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Call a smooth complex affine algebraic variety $X$ of complex dimension $n$ an exotic $\mathbb{C}^n$ if $X$ is diffeomorphic to $\mathbb{R}^{2n}$ but $X$ is not isomorphic, as an algebraic variety, to the affine space $\mathbb{C}^n$. Recall that $X$ is said to be rational if its field of rational functions $\mathbb{C}(X)$ is purely transcendental over $\mathbb{C}$, i.e. isomorphic to $\mathbb{C}(t_1,\dots,t_n)$. Does there exist, for some $n\geq 2$, an exotic $\mathbb{C}^n$ which is not rational?

status_evidence.title: Challenging problems on affine n-space (Kraft)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey on exotic affine spaces and related rationality questions; discusses Zaidenberg's exotic structures on C^n.
status_evidence.claim: The problem of non-rational exotic C^n is discussed among open challenges concerning affine n-space, without a known resolution.

status_evidence.title: Exotic analytic structures and Eisenman intrinsic measures
status_evidence.snippet: Constructions of exotic analytic/algebraic structures on C^n, n>=3.
status_evidence.claim: Known constructions of exotic C^n yield rational varieties; non-rational examples are not provided here.
